steps.text: 7:10 A.M. \ Clear
Kazdel exurbs

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: This is the mission location?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Judging by the image, this should be the place. The nomadic hamlet Bellony Village.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Though I think you could just call the entire village an oversized minecart instead.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: It's a mining town that carries around its own Originium-powered drills to keep itself going. The people bring in some revenue just selling the excess resources to nearby cities.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: If they find any big ruins, they even ask the larger nomadic cities to front the excavation costs.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Maybe, but this place still looks pretty rough.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: There is dust everywhere and the fences are all run-down. There are obvious signs of habitation, but no one cares to do maintenance?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I don't see anything worth investigating.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Most of Terra isn't very interesting, but the people living in these uninteresting places still have their own unique lifestyles.

steps.name: Scrawny Kid
steps.text: Wait, give that back!

steps.name: Mischievous Kid
steps.text: What?! You said you'd share your ice cream!

steps.name: Scrawny Kid
steps.text: Stop running! You're gonna squish it before we get home!

steps.name: Scrawny Kid
steps.text: Idiot, give that back!

steps.name: Mischievous Kid
steps.text: No way! I'm faster than you anyway. I'll be the one to bring it back to Dad!

steps.name: Scrawny Kid
steps.text: Wait up!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: There are many who struggle to survive in such terrible environments, but that doesn't mean they're unhappy.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: They chase after one another for a mere ice-cream without regard to the commotion they are causing. To think they will be the same when they grow up...

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: You call this happiness?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Are you angry?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Why would some inconsiderate kids running around, kicking up dust anger me?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (She's totally angry.)

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Sorry. Are you the operators from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Real sorry to keep you waiting.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Yes, we are. Nice to meet you, are you the local liaison?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Ah, yeah, that's right. I'm the leader of Bellony Village. Come with me. No need to stand around out here, let's go in. This way.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Thank you.
Before the mission
Rhodes Island Command Center

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Bellony Village is a typical mining community located at the edge of Kazdel. A cave-in a few months ago completely sealed off the mines.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Not only were the mines ruined, the village's travel route and trading channels were also blocked.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For the past few months, the village has been requesting aid from nearby nomadic cities, but there has not yet been any city willing to help.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Meteorite, I would like you to carry out preliminary investigations and report on the situation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We will organize a rescue mission based on that report.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Understood. This doesn't sound like a particularly tough mission.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The village's problems don't appear to be related to Catastrophes or Oripathy, but don't let your guard down.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Roger that. But...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Is Surtr going too? I don't think I'll need much help.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: There is something I want to investigate in that area.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Surtr asked to go along for personal reasons. We've approved her request.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I won't be a burden to you, just pay me no mind.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: We're a small village. Just wait here for a moment, I'll go and grab some tools first.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Oh, we have some basic prospecting tools with us.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: No good, the mine entrance at the edge of the village has been sealed off with our own special tools.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Without these unlocking tools, it can't be opened. Our village is pretty good at excavation, if I do say so myself.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Even with all that experience, you still got yourselves stuck here.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Hahaha, that's true.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Aah! Please forgive her, she doesn't mean it. Hey, don't be rude!

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: No, we are really ashamed that for all our experience excavating, we still couldn't stop a major cave-in.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Part of the drill sunk into the collapsed area, so it's not safe to send anyone else over there.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Even with Rhodes Island's help, we're going to put some new precautions in place.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Just rest here a minute, I'll get the stuff.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Alright, please do.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: You know, you could stand to be a little more polite.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I'm just stating facts.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Ah... Err...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (This is so awkward.)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (I've heard Surtr is tough to get along with, but I thought we'd at least have something to talk about.)

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: ......(Recording)

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Are you taking notes for a status report?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: You don't know? I thought my file was public.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: I did read it, but...
Surtr. The file mentioned her.
Due to a memory impairment of unknown origins, she has difficulty reconciling her memories.
It is as if there is a large volume of memories existing simultaneously in her mind. The volume is such that Surtr is unable to properly recognize which of her memories are real and which are false.
And so she has been seeking out the places in her memories one by one.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: The 'personal reasons' Dr. Kal'tsit mentioned are some places around here you remember?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: When Dr. Kal'tsit was telling me about this area, I felt a sense of familiarity.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: And I felt some deja vu when looking at photographs and records.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Now that you're here at the village, do you recall anything?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Nothing at all. When walking through the village, I saw the passing children and the run-down houses. They are similar to the images in my memory, yet completely different.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I do not know why.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Have you checked every spot in the village?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: At a quick glance, I haven't missed anything.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: How about we ask the villagers later? Maybe the village you remember is from a while ago? It could've been rebuilt.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: ...Perhaps.
The smell of dried plants in the air is no different from my memories.
When I close my eyes, it is as if I am on familiar streets.
The footsteps of children running by are like the sounds of friends chasing one another in my memories.
Yet when I open my eyes, I see nothing but an unfamiliar landscape.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit sent me on this mission, so let me help you investigate.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: We'll look for clues in the village together after we're done with the mine collapse thing.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: No need, I can handle it myself.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...I understand how it feels to have no past, or a place to call home.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: As Sarkaz, without a Sarkaz home, I'm always fighting, together with the others, pressing on.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: My situation is different.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Maybe it's different, maybe it's the same?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Maybe we're all just looking for a place to belong in the end.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: But, as you look towards the unknown future, you can't ignore what's right beside you.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: That's what Amiya taught me.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Sorry for the wait, let's set out now!

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: I'm all ready!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Anyway, let's complete our mission first.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: So this is it...

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Yep, this is the cave-in. Watch your step.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: The excavation site is over there. The cave-in caused the surrounding area to sink downwards, so this entire area had to be sealed off.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: This cave used to be the entrance to a tunnel that connects to the neighboring village. Now that it's sealed, we can't trade with our neighbors.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Surtr?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I think I remember this path.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Sir, what's the relationship between this village and the neighboring one?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: It's a mining village just like ours. Since the nearby villages are all in the same business, we deal with each other a lot.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Some villagers even move back and forth between the communities.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: But the cave-in blocked off our only means of communication. They've probably already moved on to keep mining.
The course of this path, the direction...
It's getting more familiar.
I used to pass through this place often.
The familiar figures of children run past me and disappear among the piles of rocks up ahead.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: You want to go to another village?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: If we got the path open, we could contact them pretty quickly.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: That would be great... Surtr?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I'm not willing to wait that long.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Move aside!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Surtr, wait! I know you're eager for answers, but the mine isn't safe right now!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Think for a minute before you put yourself in danger!

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Meteorite, just wait for me outside and guard the entrance!

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: The girl! She actually smashed through the rubble and rushed in!?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Hey, wait!

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Stop! Don't you go in there too!

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: You're risking another cave-in!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Damn it!! Surtr!
Deep within the mine, the traces of heavy machinery are obvious.
The path snakes ahead, as if guiding Surtr forward.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: So this is the path to that other village.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: It's just an Originium Slug nest now.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: It looks like they took over the empty space in the past few months.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Troublesome.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Hm...
Children holding hands walk along the path.
Passing by the countless traces of Originium Slugs.
Disappearing into the darkness ahead.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: An explosion!

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Another cave-in!?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: That girl is in danger! What do we do!?
The streets in my memories were filled with the rich aroma of the earth, not the scent of dried plants.
The companions in my memories would not chase after one another, ice-cream in hand.
The buildings looked the same, yet were completely different.
It was not just minor differences in the design. Even the materials and structures were completely different.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Ah, I'm hurt. Ouch. My palm's scratched.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Never thought there would be a day I got distracted enough to get ambushed by Originium Slugs.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: This... this is...

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: There's another empty space beneath the mining pit?
(Rustle rustle). It's the sound of Originium Slugs.
(Rustle rustle).
(Rustle rustle).

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: The ruins of a city in a giant cavern...?
Surtr enters the cavern deep beneath the earth.
Beside the glow of Originium Slugs, she can trace the outlines of buildings among the piles of stone and rubble.
Tiles of a road, bricks of a wall.
It is very clear that the entire place has been buried for a very long time.
Dozens of years? Hundreds of years?
Surtr does not know either. Yet, she has found that which she is looking for.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Here!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Surtr!

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Ah, thanks for pinpointing the location. I was able to break the rock layer at the correct spot.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: What were you thinking?! Why would you rush into such a dangerous place all by yourself?!

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I was doing a little thing called 'investigating'.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Incidentally, I discovered the cause of the cave-ins. There was a nest of Originium Slugs below the mine, inside a giant cavern.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: The mining put more pressure on the bottom, so the whole thing just collapsed.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I destroyed the Originium Slug nest and used the cave-in to seal up the entire cavern. Done.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Though we skipped over the standard procedures, the issue was resolved.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: What!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: So, you solved the whole problem by yourself, but you didn't find the path to the neighboring village?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Right, I realized that neither village was the one in my memory.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I made a mistake. There aren't any memories I'm looking for here.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: You'd mess up something you recorded so diligently all this while?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I suppose I would.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: I've seen something like this before.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: You run into all sorts of problems on the way to your goal.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: It's thanks to the people beside me that I've made it this far.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: I'm used to it.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: After all, this isn't the first time there was a discrepancy in the places I remember.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: But even if you didn't find the right place today, you still have a place to call home, right?

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Are you trying to say I can rely on you too?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Um, I guess you could put it that way...

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Ladies! I've notified the others in the village!

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: The exploration team is getting ready! It sounds like you've taken care of things and we can get back to mining.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Please wait for us to bring our data back to Rhodes Island before you go back in there.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: We wouldn't want any more accidents.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Hahaha, that's fine. Everyone's too excited. I really have to thank you both.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: If you don't mind, why don't you spend the night in the village?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: You'll be our guests of honor!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: We have to hurry back, so I'm afraid we'll pass.

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Surtr
steps.text: Could I have an ice-cream?
